documents.title: MOA 2514 revision: syllabus AI requirements
documents.quality_note: Signed revision to the syllabus-requirements policy that requires an AI statement in every syllabus; AI is one requirement in a longer syllabus policy.

notes: WMU has no blanket AI policy beyond the student code of conduct; instructors set rules. The wmich.edu 'Compliance and Policy Requirements for Gen-AI' page (v2-wmu-aireq) only links to the IT approved-tools policies, so it is not listed. No CEAS or Computer Science department AI policy found.
